text:
Ground beetle (Calleida sp.) -- a beneficial insect.

Description: a dark-coloured, shiny, hard-bodied beetle typically found on the soil surface.

Role: both larval and adult stages are predators; larvae in particular feed on the eggs and small larvae of pest species including Spodoptera sp. (armyworm) and Heliothis/Helicoverpa sp. (corn earworm), contributing to natural pest control in the field.
